description: Synthetic queries that should and should not load lt-module-capture. The format matches dev/claude-code/run_trigger_eval.py (cases with id, query, should_trigger). A runner that needs a train and validation split takes every third case of each kind for validation.

cases.query: Copy the Lt lesson in my open tab to disk so I can study it without the browser
How many questions does this Lt practical have, and can any of them only be answered once?
List what I have not answered yet in the Lt lesson I have open
Make a module.json from this Lt run first
Read the structure of the module out of my Lt tab without changing anything on the page
Where are the checkpoints and single-attempt questions in this Lt run?
Get every page title and question prompt from the Lt module that is open
The diagram step needs the image slot sizes from this Lt lesson, can you read them out
Start by snapshotting the Lt module, we will draft answers later
Turn the open Lt run into the files the other lt-suite skills read
We filled the module, refresh module.json from the live page without touching the reference
Draft answers for the module we captured earlier
Answer the team-based learning questions using this week's slides as sources
Build the mechanism diagram for this case
Make a draw.io figure of this signalling pathway with blunt-ended inhibition edges
Put my drafted answers into the Lt pages, stopping at the first checkpoint
Enter the approved answers in Lt but leave submitting to me
Export the module notes to my notes app
Turn these answers into flashcards
Fix errors in this lecture transcript
Count the items by type in the module.json that is already saved
